## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Pricing and paywall.**
      1 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jul 28, 2026 - Jul 30, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _João Santos_, Jul 30, 2026, 1/5: "Advertise 2 month free trial on premium plan, but will charge you a cancelation fee hidden in the contract if you cancel. they offer you 2 months if you accept paying for an entire year. IT'S NOT A FREE TRIAL"
            2. _P. B._, Jul 28, 2026, 1/5: "Very disappointing support. I had a Revolut account for about three years and used the Platinum plan twice. The app benefits worked well the first time, but about half failed during the second subscription. Worse, Revolut accepted money into my already closed account without informing me or the sender. My identity and account ownership were already verified, yet I was repeatedly asked for the same information. The process is slow, uncoordinated and unresolved."
